item.title: DEAD BODY FOUND PROMPTS INVESTIGATION HENDERSON COUNTY SHERIFF'S OFFICE SAYS
item.description: On Thursday, Jan. 22, the Henderson County Sheriff's Office said an investigation is underway involving a deceased person. News 13 reached out to the sheriff's office about a possible dead body found at Pace Road near Pace Creek Road. Public information officer Stephanie Barbosa said the sheriff's office responded to the call. Investigators confirmed no foul play at this time, according to Barbosa. STORY COURTESY OF ABC 13 WLOS.

item.title: WINTER STORM WATCH ISSUED FOR BUNCOMBE AND HENDERSON COUNTIES STARTING FRIDAY AFTERNOON
item.description: As another winter storm moves into the western North Carolina region, Buncombe County and Henderson County will be under a winter storm watch beginning at 4 p.m. on Friday, Jan. 29. The winter storm watch will remain in effect through Saturday night. According to a release from Buncombe County, the county says, unlike the ice storm last week, no significant impacts to power are expected.
